title: Strong-to-Weak Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking in a $(2+1)$D Transverse-Field Ising Model under Decoherence
summary: Decoherence in many-body quantum systems can give rise to intrinsically mixed-state phases and phase transitions beyond the pure-state paradigm. Here we study the $(2+1)$D transverse-field Ising model subject to a strongly $\mathbb{Z}_2$-symmetric decoherence channel, with a focus on strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SWSSB).
